Write the text 100% Unique, SEO-optimized, Human-Written article in English that covers the topic provided in the Prompt. Now write a short text covering the pricing of Bluehost. Refrain from writing an introduction or conclusion or making a bullet list with all of the pricing plans. Simply write a short text covering the most important information for each plan and the free version if it exists. Use 100-150 words.
sample.chosen: If you're on the hunt for a reliable and budget-friendly web hosting service, Bluehost has got you covered with a range of plans to suit your needs. Their Free Starter plan is a great way to dip your toes in the water, offering 2GB of storage and 1GB of bandwidth, perfect for beginners or small projects. For those ready to level up, the $3.95/month Shared Hosting plan provides 20GB of storage and 10GB of bandwidth, ideal for small to medium-sized websites. If you're looking to expand your online presence, the $6/month VPS Hosting plan offers 50GB of storage and 20GB of bandwidth, giving you more control and resources. Bluehost's pricing is designed to accommodate various website sizes and traffic volumes, ensuring you get the best value for your investment.
sample.rejected:
Bluehost is a popular web hosting provider that offers a range of plans to suit different needs and budgets. Their basic plan, called "Basic," starts at just $2.95 per month and includes one website, 50GB of website space, and unmetered bandwidth. This plan is great for small personal or business websites that don't expect a lot of traffic.

Next up is the "Plus" plan, which starts at $5.45 per month. This plan includes unlimited websites, unmetered website space, unmetered bandwidth, and additional features like spam experts and $200 in marketing offers. This plan is a good choice for small to medium-sized businesses that need more resources and features.

The "Choice Plus" plan is the most popular option, starting at $5.45 per month. It includes all the features of the Plus plan, as well as domain privacy and CodeGuard Backup Basic. This plan is ideal for businesses that want the added security and protection for their website.

Lastly, the "Pro" plan starts at $13.95 per month and includes all the features of the Choice Plus plan, as well as high performance and high dedicated resources. This plan is perfect for large businesses or websites that expect a lot of traffic.

It's important to note that these prices are promotional and will increase after the initial term. Also, Bluehost offers a free domain for the first year with any plan, and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
